authorization: Publisher authorised three verified daily company-analysis articles on 2 November 2026, superseding the repository's one-new-article daily cap.
story_thesis: Cash App lending is accelerating gross profit and retained credit exposure; the test is whether stable loss rates and attractive returns survive further scale.
duplicate_checks: Checked editorial index, both inventories and actual wealth Markdown; Block had a maintained /stocks/xyz/ profile but no dedicated lending-and-credit analysis.
Checked open PRs 57 and 43, recent merged publication PRs, company-publication records and live content; no matching Block story or fingerprint was active.
Checked the 4 November Europe/Dublin scheduled publication count before drafting; no scheduled new company-analysis article had been published.
The article analyses lending economics rather than recapping the quarter; routine figures remain on /stocks/xyz/.
candidate_review_reference: See a5b5496690fd217fbefcd647.json for the eight-company batch screen; Block was selected independently.

evidence_table.claim: Gross profit was USD3.235bn, up 22%; Cash App gross profit grew 27% and Financial Solutions gross profit 32%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Shareholder letter performance discussion and 10-Q revenue/cost tables.
Shareholder letter lending KPI; consumer lending defined as Cash App Borrow and BNPL products.

evidence_table.claim: Q3 transaction, loan and consumer-receivable losses were USD601.706m, up 66%, including USD439.008m loan losses.
evidence_table.result: verified; management says underlying loss rates and portfolio credit performance remained stable

evidence_table.claim: Loans held for investment net were USD4.401bn and allowance USD640.566m at September, versus USD3.383bn and USD382.861m at December.
evidence_table.result: verified; ratio caveat includes mix and origination timing

evidence_table.claim: GAAP operating income was USD428.491m; adjusted operating income was USD923m and adjusted margin 29%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: 10-Q income statement and shareholder-letter non-GAAP tables.
evidence_table.result: verified; GAAP and adjusted measures not mixed

evidence_table.claim: Nine-month operating cash flow was USD3.002bn and investing outflows included USD1.9bn mainly for retained Cash App Borrow and Afterpay Post-Purchase loans.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: 10-Q cash-flow statement and MD&A; accrued legal contingencies identified as a working-capital contributor.

fact_check_pass.method: Every material number, period, loan classification, accounting measure, management explanation and calculation was reread against the SEC-furnished shareholder letter and Form 10-Q; arithmetic was recomputed independently.
